question: In which modern-day region of India was the 'Panchala' Mahajanapada located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Western Uttar Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Panchala Mahajanapada** was one of the **sixteen great kingdoms** (Mahajanapadas) of ancient India, flourishing between the **6th and 4th centuries BCE** as documented in the Buddhist text **Anguttara Nikaya**.
